entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I'd like to start a return for an order I received recently.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is VF88712.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the AeroFlow helmet. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just a preference thing. The color on the website looked like a bright red, but in person, it's more of a maroon. It just doesn't match my bike. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.
Okay, I understand. So no issues with the helmet itself, just not the color you were hoping for. Let me pull up the return policy for you. One moment.

Alright, Sarah. I see here that the item was delivered 17 days ago. Our policy states that you have 90 days to return an item, so you are well within the window. Since the box is unopened, I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund immediately.

That's great news, thank you. Before we finalize that, I was wondering if there's any flexibility. Since I'm going to be buying another helmet from you in a different color, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase to offset the hassle of the return?

I'm glad we can get the return sorted for you. I appreciate you asking, but I'm afraid my system doesn't allow for discount codes on preference-based returns. I can, however, get this return label sent to your email right now so you can get your refund processed as quickly as possible.
I see. Well, a full refund is still a good outcome. I just want to double-check that all your helmets have the same high safety rating, regardless of the finish or color.

That's an excellent question. Yes, absolutely. Every VeloFit helmet meets the highest safety certifications. Your protection is our top priority. I've just sent that return authorization to your email. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. Thank you for making that so easy, David.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day!
